title: Sophisticated Backpacks: Omega Crafting
description: Addon for Sophisticated Backpacks. Adds a single Upgrade that embeds the eight vanilla workstation upgrades in one backpack slot.
body:
# Sophisticated Backpacks: Omega Crafting

NeoForge addon for [Sophisticated Backpacks]([https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sophisticated-backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)). 
Adds a single **Crafting Upgrade Omega Tier** that embeds eight workstation upgrades in one backpack slot.

## Included upgrades

- Stonecutter
- Crafting
- Smithing
- Anvil
- Advanced Jukebox
- Auto Blasting
- Auto Smelting
- Auto Smoking

## Requirements

| Mod | Version |
|-----|---------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.1 |
| NeoForge | 21.1+ |
| Sophisticated Core | 1.4.x |
| Sophisticated Backpacks | 3.25.x |
